name: Sweet 'n Juicy Organic Berry Farm
description: Sweet 'n Juicy Organic Berry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 242 East Southfield Road, UT. The farm is working, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
